activeProjects.description: Number of projects in the workspace. There is no "active" flag in the domain — every project counts.

agentCount.description: Distinct agents (actorKind=agent) that spent tokens this month, summed across all of the workspace's projects — includes area subspecialties (Phase 8).

spentMicros.description: Current month's spend, in micro-USD, summed by token_usage.createdAt.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
